findings.explanation: The retry realization limits the retry to one attempt and requires prior classification, but its constraints omit the required classification outcome. A prior classification also occurs on the non-transient branch. The fixed CFG already routes the retry through the true result of the first-error transient check.
findings.suggestion: Bind an only_if restriction on the retry request to the true result of ir_008. The CFG already limits that check to the first fast call's failure path.

findings.explanation: The realization restricts FAST_KEY delivery only at the status.txt append. Line 15 prohibits including FAST_KEY in diagnostic output anywhere in the workflow. The gap acknowledges the broader scope, but the restriction itself covers only the named write.
findings.suggestion: Record the workflow-wide diagnostic-output prohibition in the realization. Retain the status.txt append as the concrete event and preserve the limitation on mapping any other diagnostic emissions to event coordinates.
